LanguageData.WotF_SpellStaff.label: spell staff
LanguageData.WotF_SpellStaff.description: A full-length, two-handed spell staff — properly a staff rather than a quick one-handed wand, even if colonists casually call both "staves". Steadied with both hands, it channels a spellbook bookmark at full reach, amplifies material resonance to higher ceilings, and anchors super runes; in return it cannot be fired while wearing a ranged-blocking shield belt. Without a saved spell in its chosen bookmark it cannot attack.
LanguageData.WotF_SpellWand.label: spell wand
LanguageData.WotF_SpellWand.description: People keep calling it a "short spell staff", though by proper fantasy convention this nimble one-handed focus is strictly a wand, not a two-handed staff. Worn in the offhand without displacing a primary weapon, it can auto-cast when carried alone or fire on command alongside a blade and a shield belt — trading reach, material ceilings and super-rune support for rapid windup and compact handling.
